name: drurls
description: SEO audits in ChatGPT: list your sites with their latest audit, read every issue with its fix, check what blocks Google indexing, and start new audits.

interface.longDescription:
DrUrls audits websites for SEO. Connect it and ChatGPT can work with your sites' audits directly: list your sites with their latest score and grade, read the issues each audit found across SEO, performance, security and accessibility with the fix for each, check what blocks Google from indexing a site, get a ranked improvement plan, compile a report, and start a fresh audit of any public website.

A single public page can also be checked without an account.

Connecting asks you to sign in to DrUrls (Google, GitHub or an emailed link) and approve. Approval creates a key that only works for this connection, has no team or billing rights, and can be revoked any time from your DrUrls dashboard.
capabilities: List your sites with their latest SEO score and grade
Read each audit's issues with the fix for each
Find open issues across sites by severity
Check what blocks Google from indexing a site
Start a fresh audit of a public website
Rank the fixes that touch the most pages
Check a single public page without an account
defaultPrompt: Which of my sites have critical SEO issues?
Is anything stopping Google from indexing my site?
Check the SEO of the page https://example.com

positive.description: Finds the sites with critical issues and gives the fix for each
positive.prompt: Which of my sites have critical SEO issues, and what is the fix for each?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_issues with severity critical and lists each site, issue type, pages affected and the fix. A new account with no audited site gets a clear 'no audits yet' answer.

positive.description: Explains whether anything blocks Google indexing
positive.prompt: Is anything stopping Google from indexing my sites?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_google_visibility and explains per site whether noindex tags, robots blocks, sitemap or canonical problems block indexing.

positive.description: Starts an audit and reports progress
positive.prompt: Audit example.com and tell me when it is done.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_scan for example.com, then get_scan_status to report progress; when the scan completes, summarises the score and grade.

positive.description: Lists the user's sites with their latest scores
positive.prompt: List my sites and their latest SEO scores.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_sites and returns each site with its latest score, grade, issues found and when it was last audited.

positive.description: Checks one public page without an account
positive.prompt: Check the SEO of the page https://example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls free_page_check for the URL and returns its score, grade, categories and issues.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.
What is the capital of Australia?

publication.release_notes: First release: SEO audits, issues with fixes, Google indexability checks and new audits, over OAuth.
